info.title: Clinical Cohort Recompute Service
info.description: Multi-centre clinical cohort screening with full and incremental recomputation, unit/code normalization, reconciliation gates and immutable versioned snapshots and reports. All patients are fictional.

post.description:
Re-standardize the source rows a new mapping covers.

``dry_run=true`` (default) reports which rows would become standardizable
and which subjects need re-screening. Applying changes only derived
normalized values; hospital source rows are untouched.
Continue an interrupted upload from its last committed row.

get.description: Rows that could not be standardized, with the reason and source row.

post.description:
Re-run the same protocol and cutoff with the other strategy and compare
every subject decision. The two strategies must agree exactly.

Terminate future contact immediately.

Data already collected and permitted for retention still flows into the
safety analysis through the next screening run; this endpoint only stops
outreach, it does not delete history.

get.description: Full traceability from a study id back to hospital source rows.

post.description:
Record that the research lead reviewed the dossier. This never
re-approves the protocol and never edits a report.

Semantic condition diff between two revisions.

Nodes are compared by stable condition id and semantic content, so two
people editing the same tree concurrently get a node-level alignment —
never a splice of two individually legal fragments into a third meaning.

get.description: Fictional demo identities for local verification only.
